transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the duty roster for the three uncovered exercise shifts — Tuesday 0600-1400, Wednesday 1400-2200, and Thursday 2200-0600 — I need to hear from each of you on a couple of things. First, per our standing Monday personnel-sync routine, the company commanders and S-1 officer need to report any roster changes before I publish the schedule. Second, each assignment on the final roster must include a named shift handoff. So let's work through this: Alpha, Bravo, and battalion support staff will each cover one shift, and no team covers more than one. I'd like to hear from each of you which shift you're prepared to take and who your named handoff point of contact will be.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Alpha Company's only currently qualified exercise-cell supervisor is Sgt. Ellis, and he is available only for the Tuesday 0600-1400 shift. He begins an instructor course Tuesday afternoon. I confirmed the course enrollment this morning, but the updated availability is not yet on the battalion roster. This is my roster change report for the Monday personnel-sync routine.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Bravo Company's designated cell team must cover the Wednesday 1400-2200 shift because our communications liaison is scheduled for a certification appointment Thursday morning and cannot support the Thursday overnight handoff. I received the appointment confirmation yesterday, but it has not been added to the exercise staffing worksheet. This is my roster change report for the Monday personnel-sync routine.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report a roster change for the Monday personnel-sync routine. I received a signed higher-headquarters personnel directive this morning requiring the battalion support staff team to cover the Thursday 2200-0600 shift, with the handoff logged to the duty officer. This directive has not yet been posted to the published roster.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Maj. Alvarez will publish the final duty roster incorporating all three reported roster changes from the Monday personnel-sync routine.
Thursday 2200-0600 shift handoff will be logged to the duty officer per the higher-headquarters directive.
Each shift assignment on the published roster will include a named shift handoff point of contact.
